correctness.rationale: Weighted spanning tree factorization holds exactly for every cactus. The grounded Laplacian embedding for a simple connected graph is injective, so log determinant is strictly concave on positive-tree-support feasible weights. Polynomial homogeneity yields block spending d_H B/(n−1). On each cycle face, differentiation at its unique face optimum shows KKT iff the omitted edge price is at least the sum of the other edge prices. Interior KKT and explicit one-exception algebra finish the exhaustive positive/one-zero classification. The exact rational and floating-point checks independently corroborate finite examples but are not used as infinite proof.
